In the Korean peninsula , Du Fu 's influence was also significant . The Korean poet Kim Yongs - min , for example , wrote a poem in the style of Du Fu . In the 19th century , the Korean scholar and poet Pak Yŏng - hyo wrote a series of poems in the style of Du Fu . In the 20th century , the Korean poet and scholar Kim Tong - hui wrote a critical study of Du Fu 's poetry . However , in the late Tang dynasty , the poet and critic Jia Dao ( 799 - 863 ) and the poet Han Yu ( 768 - 824 ) began to appreciate and promote his work . They were followed by the Northern Song dynasty poet and scholar Ouyang Xiu ( 1009 - 1071 ) and the poet and critic Su Shi ( 1037 - 1101 ) , who were also influenced by the " Han and Liu " movement ( the Han and Liu refer to the famous Han Yu and Liu Zongyuan ) , which emphasized the importance of the " classical " style of writing . This movement was a reaction to the " parallelism " style of the Liang and Chen dynasties , which was considered to be overly ornate and artificial . The " classical " style emphasized simplicity and naturalness , which is similar to the style of Du Fu . Therefore , the " classical " style of the Northern Song dynasty was influenced by Du Fu 's work .
